player_prompt.intro:
O dula Mastermind.
O nyaka go fumana codi e le {code_length} digits teele, each digit go tswa go 1 go {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Ka karabo ya gago, o ka kgetha tshono ya gago ka tsela e latelang: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Morago ga tshono ya gago, o tla amogela tokomelo ka tsela ya peg(e) ye mmala wa black le peg(e) ye mmala wa white.
Peg(e) ye mmala wa black e bontsha digit e memele ka sebaka se memele, ha peg(e) ye mmala wa white e bontsha digit e memele ka sebaka se sejwe.
O na le {max_turns} matšatši go kgetha codi.
player_prompt.with_repeats: ka go boeletšwa mo gongwe le gona
player_prompt.no_duplicates: ka ntle le dikopi tše pedi tša yona

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga se wa araba ka lelokelelo la dinomoro tšeo di arogantšwego ke dikgoba tše dikgolo.
invalid_move.not_integers: Diteng ka moka di swanetše go ba dinomoro tše feletšego tšeo di nepagetšego.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Go šišinya go swanetše go ba le dinomoro tša {code_length} ka mo go nepagetšego.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Dinomoro ka moka di swanetše go ba magareng ga 1 le {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Dinomoro tša go swana ga di dumelelwe.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: O šetše o naganne ka {guess}. Ka kgopelo leka go nagana ka tsela e nngwe.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: O ile wa hlola codi, o solofetse {black_pegs} ka moka {code_length} pegs ka tsela e memele.
outcome.turn_limit: O ile wa feletša ka go phopholetša {percent} lekgolong ya dinomoro gabotse.
